definitions.explanation: The return of money paid, such as when canceling a purchase, unused tickets, or overpayment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{払戻|はらいもど}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a refund for the ticket.

examples.japanese: {払戻|はらいもど}し⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A refund processing fee will be charged.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{払戻|はらいもど}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In case of cancellation, refunds are not available.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (paying) + ⟦{戻|もど}し→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (returning)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {払戻|はらいもど}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a refund)
- {払戻|はらいもど}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧ (to request a refund)
- {払戻|はらいもど}し⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ (refund fee)
- {払戻|はらいもど}し⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (refund deadline)

USAGE:
Commonly used for transportation tickets, event tickets, insurance policies, and financial products. The term is more formal than 「⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧」.
